name: dev-flow
description: Plan-first development for agent sessions — investigation series, reviewed plans, verified implementation, a sub-agent dev cycle that carries one change from plan to merge, multi-agent research fan-outs, a research skill family that turns a question into sourced, verified findings and a curated knowledge base (with the research-lane and research-verifier agents), chain-of-verification fact-checking, and a standing librarian that takes custody of a repo's work: files, dispatches, reviews and lands (soft dependencies: work-items; statusline-hub, whose sensor record gives rate-limit reset times, the quota sense's usage and the research skills' quota; claude-analytics (external, planned), whose sampler sink the quota sense reads as usage history, else it samples into ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}/claude-kit/librarian/; context-guard, for checkpoint and rehydration; kit-dev, whose update-kit takes retrospective findings; create-repo, which investigate's scoping gate points to when the target repo does not exist yet).
